pages.text: $(bold)Transformation Mechanics$()$(br2)The $(item)X-Pill$() allows you to transform into any girl in the game. While transformed, your player model changes to match the selected girl, and you can access her unique scenes.$(br2)Use another $(item)X-Pill$() to revert back to your normal form.

$(bold)How to Transform:$()$(br)$(li)Craft an $(item)X-Pill$() (see recipe on next page)$(li)Right-click with the $(item)X-Pill$() to open the girl selection screen$(li)Choose the girl you want to transform into$(li)You are now transformed!$(br2)$(bold)While Transformed:$()$(br)$(li)Press the $(item)Transform Scene$() keybind to start a scene$(li)Use another $(item)X-Pill$() to revert back to human form$(br2)$(o)Note: The X-Pill is consumed on use (unless in Creative mode).$()
Craft the X-Pill using a poppy, sugar, a potion, an apple, and a bowl.
